name: Money exchange and remittance agents

problems.words: Day-end closing never matches on the first count and finding the difference takes an hour
quick_ideas: Count each till by denomination on paper at close, so a difference shows which notes it sits in
Write a reason next to every short or excess the same evening, so patterns appear instead of fading.

workzap_build.text: A day-end closing sheet on phone for every till and branch that flags variances automatically, keeps the reason and shows the owner each evening which counters matched.

problems.ask_first: How many counters run in a normal shift?
problems.free_stops: The closing sheet layout and variance rules are in the solution document.

problems.words: One counter keeps coming up short and I cannot prove who
quick_ideas: Give each till to one person per shift, so responsibility is never shared
Count the till with both staff present at every handover, so a gap is tied to a shift, not a guess.

workzap_build.text: A shift and till handover log with opening float, handover count and closing signed off by role, showing which shift a variance began in.

problems.free_stops: Handover steps and sign-off rules are covered in the solution document; pi records the control gap, never names staff.

problems.words: We hold too much cash at the branch overnight and it worries me
quick_ideas: Agree with your principal or cash-in-transit provider whether collections can be more frequent, so less sits overnight
Set an owner-decided ceiling for branch cash and note each day it is crossed, so the risk is visible.

workzap_build.text: A daily cash position view per branch against the owner's ceiling, flagging days it was exceeded (security details stay out of the system).

problems.free_stops: How the ceiling is tracked and reported is in the solution document; pi does not record vault or movement details.

problems.words: Running out of certain notes or currencies mid-day and turning customers away
quick_ideas: Check note and currency levels at opening and midday, so shortfalls show before the rush
Note every request you had to turn away, so you know what demand you are missing.

workzap_build.text: A note and currency stock tracker per branch that alerts the owner when a denomination or currency drops below the level they set.

problems.free_stops: Alert levels and how counts feed the tracker are in the solution document.

problems.words: Moving currency between branches is done by phone and the count is sometimes wrong on arrival
quick_ideas: Count and sign at dispatch and again at receipt, so a gap is caught at the handover
Keep one written transfer record for every movement, so none rely on a phone call.

workzap_build.text: An inter-branch transfer log with confirm-on-receipt that flags any transfer sent but not confirmed or received short.

problems.free_stops: Confirmation steps and exception rules are detailed in the solution document.

problems.words: Queues on Fridays and after salary days are so long people walk out
quick_ideas: Tally customers per hour for two weeks, so you see exactly when the queue peaks
Move breaks and extra staff onto those hours, so capacity follows demand.

workzap_build.text: A staff roster built from hourly footfall tallies, with shift reminders and late-arrival tracking for peak days.

problems.free_stops: How tallies turn into a roster is in the solution document.

problems.words: Customers call and WhatsApp all day asking whether their money has arrived
quick_ideas: Point status questions to the principal's own tracking channel, so staff are not checking one by one
Make it a rule that no transaction details are taken on WhatsApp, so customer data stays where it belongs.

workzap_build.text: A standard WhatsApp auto-reply that directs status questions to the principal's tracking channel, handling no transaction data.

problems.free_stops: The reply flow and wording are in the solution document.

problems.words: Daily reports to the principal take a staff member half a shift
quick_ideas: List exactly which figures each report needs, so nothing extra is compiled
Note how long each report takes for a week, so you see where the time goes.

workzap_build.text: A daily report that compiles branch figures from the closing sheets into the format the owner sends, with aggregates only.

problems.free_stops: Report mapping and formats go in the solution document.

problems.words: The rate board changed late and staff used the old rate at the counter
quick_ideas: Name one person per branch responsible for each board update, so it is never assumed someone else did it
Have them confirm each change to the owner straight away, so a late board is spotted quickly.

workzap_build.text: A rate board update checklist with a time-stamped confirmation per branch, flagging any branch that has not confirmed.

problems.free_stops: The checklist steps are in the solution document; pi never discusses the rates themselves.

problems.words: Counter staff leave after training and new ones make mistakes
quick_ideas: Write down the opening, handover and closing routine once, so training does not depend on one person
Pair each new joiner with one experienced staff member for their first shifts, so mistakes are caught early.

workzap_build.text: An onboarding checklist with short process guides that tracks each new joiner's progress and an incident log showing where mistakes recur.

problems.free_stops: The checklist content and incident categories are in the solution document.

never_say: Any exchange rate, rate forecast, timing advice or comparison with other providers. Anything about transfer limits, reporting thresholds, KYC or how to structure transactions; decline plainly. Anything about hawala, hundi or unlicensed transfers. Any compliance or licensing interpretation SBP, CBUAE, FINTRAC; point to the principal's compliance team. Vault locations, cash movement times or other security details, or customer and beneficiary details.

sample_reply.person: Can you give me a solution for the evening closing? Every day one of the tills is short or excess and we spend an hour finding it.
sample_reply.pi: Yes, this can be brought under control, and you can start this week on your own. 1 Give each till to one person per shift and count it with both people present at every handover, so a difference is tied to one shift. 2 Count by denomination at close and write a reason beside every short or excess that evening, so patterns show. Workzap can do this automatically for you: a handover and closing log on phone for every till that flags variances the moment they happen and gives you one evening summary across counters. Shall I have a solution document and quote prepared for you? You are free to say no.
